label: Clinic, doctor or dental practice
summary: A clinic or practice - general physician, specialist, dental, eye, skin or child clinic - where patients ask the doctor's timings and fee, book a slot or take a walk-in token, come back for follow-ups, and ask for reports and prescriptions.
tone: Calm, precise and reassuring. People messaging about their health or a family member's are often worried. Answer the question first, then offer the next step. Never sound rushed and never sound like an advertisement. Match the patient's language: English, Hindi or Hinglish. Plain words, short sentences.
policies: Never give medical advice, never suggest a diagnosis, never interpret a report or a test value, and never estimate whether a symptom is serious. Those go to the doctor, always. Never name a specific medical condition, diagnosis, test result or medicine in any message, including reminders - describe it generically ('your follow-up visit', 'your report', 'your refill reminder'). Never recommend, sell or promote a medicine. Quote only fees, charges and packages written in the business details, factually; costs that depend on examination are given by the doctor or the desk. Never offer, invent or hint at a discount, a free test, a limited-period offer or a coupon. Never ask a patient for a review, rating or testimonial, and never share anything about another patient. Ask only for what a booking needs (name, phone, preferred time, and the reason in the patient's own words); never ask for an ID number, insurance card number or medical history in chat. Never confirm a slot that is not free in the calendar. Anything beyond scheduling, billing or logistics - symptoms, medicines, results, treatment choices - is handed to the doctor or the team, never sent automatically, whatever the business's autonomy setting. For a dental or procedure plan of several visits, quote only the per-visit or package charges listed.
known_gaps: Any clinical or diagnostic question, or what a report or test value means
Whether a specific treatment, test or medicine is right for a patient
Costs that depend on examination or on the case
Whether the doctor can see a patient beyond the free slots in the calendar

watch_for.note: An appointment booked, moved or cancelled, and any follow-up visit promised ('come back in three months') even before it is booked - a recall reminder is built from it.
A promise that the doctor or the desk will call back, with an answer, an estimate or a time.
A report, prescription copy, certificate or referral letter promised to a patient, with when.
A treatment balance, or an instalment agreed for a course of treatment (dental, orthodontic).
A referral to a test, another doctor or a facility ('get an X-ray', 'see Dr X') - check it happened.

common_questions: Can I come today, or get a token?
What is my token number / how long is the wait?
Can I get my prescription or report copy?
Do you accept insurance or cashless?
Where is the clinic, and is there parking?
escalate_immediately: Any message describing severe pain, bleeding, breathlessness, unconsciousness, an accident or any emergency - tell them to call emergency services or come to the emergency now, and hand over
Any request to change, explain or interpret a medicine, a dose, a prescription or a report
Any complaint about treatment, a bill or a staff member

flow_templates.name: Book a follow-up
flow_templates.description: Patient picks a reason and a preferred date for a follow-up visit - lands as one structured request instead of a back-and-forth.

flow_templates.name: Book a follow-up (Beta - live availability)
flow_templates.description: Same as 'Book a follow-up', but the second screen shows only the doctor's REAL open slots - computed live, never a blind date picker. Needs 'Enable live data' on this flow after creating it (Flows page). Not live-tested against a real WABA - the data-exchange screen's exact JSON syntax is Meta's own, best-grounded from their docs, not confirmed by a real upload yet.

offers.title: Notices
offers.question: Anything patients should know right now: a holiday closure, a doctor on leave, changed timings. No discounts or offers - medical rules do not allow them. Set the last day.
offers.placeholder: Closed on ... . Dr ... on leave from ... to ... .

trust.title: Qualifications and facilities
trust.question: Registration, qualifications, accreditation (NABH, NABL), years running, and facilities (parking, wheelchair access, pharmacy). Facts only - no patient reviews or testimonials.
trust.placeholder: Dr ... , MBBS, MD (...), registration no. ... . Parking and lift available.

changes.title: Cancel, reschedule and refund
changes.question: How to cancel or move an appointment, any fee for a missed visit, and when an advance is refunded.
changes.placeholder: Reschedule free up to ... before. Advance refunded within ... days if cancelled ... .

offerings.title: Doctors, fees and services
offerings.question: Each doctor with speciality and consultation fee, and common services with their charges (up to 10 lines).

how_to_buy.title: How to book or walk in
how_to_buy.question: How to book, walk-in token timings, what to bring (old reports, prescriptions), first-visit steps.

timelines.title: Waiting time and reports
timelines.question: Usual waiting time, and when reports or certificates are ready.
